_source: Generated with segno 1.6.6, an independent ISO/IEC 18004-conformant implementation, via scripts/generate-micro-fixtures.py. Each entry is the exact module matrix segno produces for that version, level and mask.
_excluded: Payload '1234' is deliberately absent. segno adds a spurious zero byte when the bit stream is already byte-aligned after the terminator (write_padding_bits uses 8 - length % 8 rather than (8 - length % 8) % 8), which also affects its full-QR output. ISO/IEC 18004 7.4.10 adds padding bits only when the stream does not end at a codeword boundary.
